subtitle: A Narrative Roleplaying Game of Heroes and Mysteries in Terrinoth
tagline: Forge your hero, choose your path, and solve the dark mysteries of a divided barony.
loreSummary: Legacy of Dragonholt transports players to the high fantasy realm of Terrinoth. Creating custom characters with distinct skills and personality traits, players embark on a grand cooperative narrative adventure without requiring a game master. Through rich paragraph-based storybooks, you will explore the village of Dragonholt, interrogate townsfolk, brave dark dungeons, and shape the destiny of the realm through consequential moral decisions.
keyFeatures: No Game Master required; fully cooperative narrative system driven by the innovative Oracle System
Deep character creation with unique lineage, class, skills, and personal backstories
Branching dialogue and choices with lasting narrative consequences across village investigations
Rich fantasy worldbuilding set in the beloved realm of Terrinoth
